definitions.explanation: The way a school refers to itself in formal writing and announcements. Used by the institution about itself, never by an outsider talking about someone else's school.

examples.japanese: {当校|とうこう}は{今年|ことし}で{創立|そうりつ}{五十年|ごじゅうねん}を{迎|むか}えます。
examples.english: Our school marks its fiftieth anniversary this year.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しくは{当校|とうこう}のホームページをご{覧|らん}ください。
examples.english: For details, please see our school's website.

examples.japanese: {当校|とうこう}では、{一人|ひとり}ひとりの{個性|こせい}を{大切|たいせつ}にした{教育|きょういく}を{行|おこな}っております。
examples.english: At our school, we provide an education that values each student's individuality.

notes:
The prefix {当|とう} ('this, the present one') is how an organization refers to itself in formal Japanese: {当社|とうしゃ} (our company), {当店|とうてん} (our shop), {当院|とういん} (our hospital or clinic), {当館|とうかん} (our hotel or museum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当校|とうこう}の{生徒|せいと}: our students
- {当校|とうこう}{独自|どくじ}の{取|と}り{組|く}み: our school's own initiative
- {当校|とうこう}にお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください: please contact the school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本校|ほんこう}: this school — also used by the school itself; additionally means the main campus as opposed to a {分校|ぶんこう} (branch campus)
- {母校|ぼこう}: alma mater — the school one graduated from, used by the former student
- わが{校|こう}: our school — warmer and more rhetorical, common in speeches
